en: A color postcard with a black border featuring a photograph of a bustling outdoor market street in a historic European city. Tall brick and stone buildings line the street, with a stepped-gable façade on the left and a prominent ornate tower with a spire in the background, part of a historic town hall-like building. White market awnings cover stalls crowded with people. At the bottom of the postcard, centered on the black border, is the word "NIJMEGEN" in white capital letters.
